Hannah: Quick sync  final preflight for tomorrow's release. We need changelog URL, canonical docs link, two bench bullets for the launch post, webinar CTA copy, canary timing, and webinar signup routing. Who's on what?
Leo: I'll take changelog + docs PR. ETA 25m.
Priya: I'll draft the webinar CTA + landing page once we have the docs link. Also need the final bench phrasing (short).
Omar: Ops propose: canary start 09:00 PT, 20m monitor, ramp 50% at 09:30, full at 10:15. Rollback if errors > 3% sustained 5m. Oncall chain = eng-oncall -> Omar -> Leo.
Hannah: Bench team please give two short metrics: median latency delta and cost/unit improvement we can use publicly. Keep copies rounded.
Leo: Draft changelog uploaded: https://git.company/release/5951234/CHANGELOG.md (WIP). Docs PR: https://docs.company/pull/1592. Tagging bench leads now.
Deploy-bot: Docs CI: passed      
Bench-lead (via Leo): Verified figures: median latency ~22% improvement, typical cost ~28% reduction. Marketing can use "up to 2x throughput" and "~30% lower per-token cost".
Priya: CTA draft: "Register for our launch webinar  see how up to 2x throughput and ~30% lower per-token cost help teams ship production LLM features faster." Thoughts?
Omar: Use "up to" — good. Please also add a short security/compliance line for Private customers on the slide.
Hannah: Inbound routing plan: webinar form -> HubSpot list 'launch_5951234' -> SDR queue; suggest hidden utm=launch_5951234. Priya can you wire webhook?
Priya: Form + webhook ready in staging: https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/5951234. Hidden utm param added. Landing page set to docs link once Leo confirms merge.
Leo: Docs merged: https://docs.company/release/5951234. Added a brief example to the docs and changelog about the canary policy.
Omar: Ops playbook snippet for release notes (pasted to #release-war-room): ```json
{"canaryStart":"09:00 PT","monitorWindowSec":1200,"rampTo":"50%","rollbackCriteria":"errors>3% for 5m"}
```
Hannah: Great. Final copy freeze at 16:00 PT. Pre-launch 15m check at 08:45 PT in #release-war-room. Any last edits drop here by 15:50. :rocket:
